idea-plugin.name: candor — effects & architecture gate
idea-plugin.description:
Every function's side-effect map, where the code is — from candor's per-function effect analysis (JVM bytecode, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust, Swift):
  • CodeLens: ⚡ Db, Net · blast radius 12 on every effectful function;
  • Diagnostics: your checked-in architecture policy ("the domain does no I/O") enforced live, violations squiggled at the offending function;
  • Hover: effect provenance — the call chain an inherited effect travels.
On JVM projects the bundled candor engine refreshes the effect report automatically after each successful build — no external tools needed. Requires Node.js on PATH (the language server runtime).

server.name: candor
server.description: candor's effect map as LSP: codeLens (effects + blast radius), architecture-gate diagnostics, and effect-provenance hover — rendered from the project's .candor/report (any candor engine).
